ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) areas, restricted to the central notch base and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark grey/black regions covering approximately 90% of the visible surface. A high-contrast white focal spot is located at the peduncle-notch intersection. Minor grey-scale mottling is visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 50 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Heterogeneous serration; left lobe trailing edge shows high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks; right lobe trailing edge is relatively smoother with localized irregular indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges on both lobes, exhibiting an upward and outward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete cluster of approximately 15-20 high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the superior-distal margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the mid-section of the left lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle infestation on the left lobe tip; distinct white depigmented patch at the central fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: The asymmetry of the barnacle cluster localized exclusively on the left lobe tip provides a unique visual identifier.
